text: dsh-profile-share 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件配置分享工具，在设置页加入「分享与同步」面板，并通过 Host 路由与 Agent 工具读取和更新 profile。用户可以选择插件及配置生成一条分享码，在另一台机器粘贴后先预览安装、开关和配置差异，再应用变更；首次配置页还会汇总缺少的密钥、环境变量和登录项，并提供相应配置指引。默认导出会从配置覆盖中移除识别出的凭据字段；需要由用户自行决定如何传递分享码。Host 端需要 Node.js ^22.19.0 或 >=24.0.0。

dsh-profile-share adds DSH web settings to export selected plugins and profile config as one code. Preview planned installs, switches, and config writes before applying on another machine. A setup page lists missing credentials; credential fields are omitted by default.
想把这台 DSH 里选好的插件设置打包发给另一台机器。
换电脑后怎么先看看要安装和修改哪些 DSH 配置，再决定是否同步？
I need to see which credentials and environment variables are still missing after importing a DSH setup.
dsh-profile-share 的功能「生成配置分享码」：在设置页选择要分享的插件，Host 会打包其启用状态和显式配置覆盖并生成单行分享码；默认排除识别出的凭据字段。
dsh-profile-share 的功能「预览并应用同步计划」：粘贴分享码后查看插件安装、启用状态和配置差异，再应用计划；Agent 导入工具也默认只预览。
dsh-profile-share 使用前须知：分享码默认排除识别出的凭据字段；分享页另有包含密钥的选项，启用后配置中的凭据也会进入分享码。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · dsh-profile-share：**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> Share a DSH plugin setup as one pasteable code.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · dsh-profile-share：`dsh-profile-share` packages the plugins you selected in a DSH profile — their enabled state and
your explicit configuration — into a single short code. Another machine pastes that code and ends
up with the same setup; subsequent codes carry only what changed. The same page then reports which
API keys, environment variables and logins each machine still has to supply for itself, because
credentials never travel in the code.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Features：- **Export** — pick plugins (all / none / invert), generate one `DSH-SHARE/1:` code. Suspected
  credential fields are stripped by default and every stripped path is listed.
- **Apply** — paste a code, preview the exact diff, then apply it. Only additions and updates by
  default; nothing is disabled or removed unless you turn on full alignment.
- **First-run configuration** — one page listing the credentials a machine still needs, with the
  secret fields writable there and login-only plugins linked to their own settings.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Requirements：- A DSH profile that mounts the `pluginManager` and `configEditor` services (the desktop and web
  profiles of DSH 0.2.x do). Endpoints answer `503` with an explicit message when either is absent.
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` for the host half.
- The receiving machine needs this plugin installed too; a share code alone cannot bootstrap it.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Installation：```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/sldmn233/dsh-profile-share
```

Or, from the plugin manager, install this checkout as a local directory. Restart DSH once after
installing. The page lives in **Settings → 分享与同步** (section id `profile-sync`).

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 1. Export a code：Open **Settings → 分享与同步 → 分享**, tick the plugins you want to carry over, and press
**生成分享码**. The result is one line of text; copy it and send it however you like.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 2. Apply a code：On the other machine open the **同步** tab, paste the code, press **预览**, and read the plan:
installations, enable/disable switches, and configuration writes. Press **应用** to run it.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 3. Finish credentials：Requirements that match a flow registered through `ctx.authorization` also get a **直接授权**
button. The flow runs in the background: its links and its questions come back to this page, and
whatever it commits is the plugin's own credential record — not this plugin guessing at a config
field. Flows that ask for a secret are never answered from chat; the agent tool refuses and points
at the page instead.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Bootstrap on a machine that does not have the plugin：A share code cannot install its own reader, so a handoff starts with one message. The **分享**
tab's **复制引导语（含码）** button copies exactly this:

```
帮我安装这个 DSH 插件：https://github.com/sldmn233/dsh-profile-share
装好后用 profile_share_import 导入下面这条分享码，先给我看计划，我确认后再用 apply=true 执行：
DSH-SHARE/1:…
```
section: Bootstrap on a machine that does not have the plugin

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Bootstrap on a machine that does not have the plugin：The receiving agent reads it, asks whether to install the plugin — that is the confirmation step —
installs it through the plugin manager, calls `profile_share_import` for a preview, applies it once
you agree, and then reports what is still missing, which is the same list the **首次配置** page
shows.

text:
@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Agent tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `profile_share_import` | preview a share code, or apply it with `apply: true` |
| `profile_share_requirements` | list the credentials this profile still lacks, with the same guidance the page shows |
| `profile_share_authorize` | list authorization flows, start one, read its prompts, answer a non-secret one, or cancel |

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Share code format：The code is `gzip(JSON)` encoded as base64url behind a `DSH-SHARE/1:` prefix. The version suffix is
checked: a code from an incompatible format is rejected instead of being half-applied. The payload
holds the selected bundles (name, version, install spec, enabled state), the explicit profile
configuration of each row, and the sender's profile name and DSH version for the header.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · How it works：The host half (`index.js`) uses only public services, so the Loader keeps owning schema validation,
the profile file lock and hot reload:

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · How it works：| Service call | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `pluginManager.listBundles()` / `listPlugins()` | read the live inventory |
| `configEditor.configuration()` | read each row's explicit profile override |
| `configEditor.edit()` | write a row's configuration back through the profile patch |
| `installBundle()` / `setBundleEnabled()` / `setPluginEnabled()` | install and switch |

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · How it works：Six endpoints live under `/api/dsh-profile-sync/`: `state`, `export`, `preview`, `apply`,
`requirements`, `configure`. Writes require `application/json` and a same-origin request, and reuse
the host's own `connection.requestRejection` admission decision.

The client half (`client.js`) is a single `settings.section` page registered through
`ctx.slots.register`, requires only `react`, and has no build step.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Security：- Suspected credentials (`apiKey`, `token`, `secret`, `password`, `cookie`, …) are removed on export
  by default, and the removed paths are reported. Enabling **包含可能的密钥字段** is an explicit,
  deliberate action.
- The code carries `apiKeyEnv`-style variable names, not the keys they name.
- Writes are same-origin only and go through the profile's own configuration editor, so every change
  is a normal, reviewable profile patch.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Behavior notes：- Bundles provided by the DSH installation itself (`availability: 'installation'`) are never
  installed; they ship with DSH. Their configuration overrides are still shared, because that is
  what reproduces the setup.
- Bundles the sender has not installed are not shared and are reported as `stats.uninstalled`.
- Registry sources install as declared; `git+…` and `file:…` declarations pass through unchanged
  rather than being guessed at as `name@version`.
- Full alignment is off by default: nothing is disabled or removed unless you ask for it.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Differences from similar plugins：[`wbb316/dsh-profile-sync`](https://github.com/wbb316/dsh-profile-sync) moves a plugin set between
two profiles on one machine and deliberately installs nothing. This plugin targets the machine-to-
machine, person-to-person case: the code is self-contained and the receiving DSH installs and
enables the delta itself. Both exist on purpose.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Project layout：```
index.js            Host half: six endpoints, snapshot codec, plan/apply engine
client.js           Client half: the settings page (three tabs)
cordis.patch.yml    Bundle patch inserting the row
locale/             Localized plugin title and description

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Development：No build step, no runtime dependencies.

```sh
npm run check              # syntax-check both halves
node test/local-smoke.mjs  # run the offline harness
```

The harness covers export and secret stripping, idempotent replay, install → enable → write on an
empty profile, requirement detection, `configure` path allow-listing, cross-origin rejection,
installation-provided bundles never being scheduled for install, row-level enable sync, and route
registration collisions during a hot reload.
@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Contributing：Issues and pull requests are welcome: <https://github.com/sldmn233/dsh-profile-share/issues>.

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · dsh-profile-share：[English](README.md) | **简体中文**

> 把一套 DSH 插件配置打包成一条可粘贴的分享码。

`dsh-profile-share` 把你在 DSH profile 里勾选的插件——连同启用状态和显式配置——打包成一条很短的
分享码。另一台机器粘贴这条码就能得到同一套配置；之后新生成的码只携带变化的部分。同一个页面还会
列出各台机器**各自**仍需要补齐的 API Key、环境变量与登录态，因为凭据永远不会进入分享码。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 功能：- **导出** —— 勾选插件（全选 / 全不选 / 反选），生成一条 `DSH-SHARE/1:` 分享码。疑似凭据字段默认
  被剥离，并逐条列出被剥离的路径。
- **应用** —— 粘贴分享码，先看精确差异，再执行。默认只新增和更新；不打开「完整对齐」就不会禁用或
  删除任何已有插件。
- **首次配置** —— 一页列出本机还缺的凭据：密钥项可直接在该页写入，需登录的插件则链接到它自己的
  设置页。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 环境要求：- DSH profile 需挂载 `pluginManager` 与 `configEditor` 两个服务（DSH 0.2.x 的 desktop / web
  profile 默认满足）。缺任何一个时端点会返回 `503` 并说明原因。
- Host 半边要求 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。
- 接收方也需要安装本插件；单靠一条分享码无法自举。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/sldmn233/dsh-profile-share
```

也可以在插件管理页用「本地目录」安装本仓库。装好后重启一次 DSH。入口在 **设置 → 分享与同步**
（section id 为 `profile-sync`）。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 1. 生成分享码：打开 **设置 → 分享与同步 → 分享**，勾选要带走的插件，点 **生成分享码**。结果是一行文本，复制后
随便用什么方式发给对方。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 2. 应用分享码：在另一台机器上打开 **同步** 标签页，粘贴分享码，点 **预览**，阅读计划：哪些要安装、哪些要开关、
哪些要写配置。确认后点 **应用**。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 3. 补齐凭据：打开 **首次配置**。检测到的每一项都会标注它是密钥、环境变量还是登录态。填**你自己的**值——
发送方的密钥从来没有进过分享码。

这一页不会只给一个输入框。每一项都带着本插件能证明的信息：

- 申请页：按环境变量名、配置里的 `baseURL`、行 id 或 bundle 名匹配出是哪家服务
  （DeepSeek、阿里云百炼、OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Moonshot、智谱、MiniMax、硅基流动、
  OpenRouter、火山方舟、Groq、WorkBuddy）；
- 环境变量给出可直接复制的 `setx` / `export` 命令，不用背语法；
- 如果插件自己的 config schema 给字段写了说明，这里一并显示。

如果某项能对上 `ctx.authorization` 里已注册的流程，还会多一个 **直接授权** 按钮：流程在后台跑，
它给出的链接和问题会回到这一页，写进去的是**插件自己的凭据记录**，而不是本插件猜某个配置字段。
需要密钥的流程不允许在对话里回答——agent 工具会拒绝，并让你回页面填写。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 在还没装插件的机器上接码：分享码无法安装它自己的解读者，所以交接从一段话开始。**分享** 标签页的 **复制引导语（含码）**
按钮复制出来的就是：

```
帮我安装这个 DSH 插件：https://github.com/sldmn233/dsh-profile-share
装好后用 profile_share_import 导入下面这条分享码，先给我看计划，我确认后再用 apply=true 执行：
DSH-SHARE/1:…
```

接收方的 agent 读到这段话后，会先问你要不要安装这个插件——这就是那一步「确认」——然后用插件管理器
装上，调 `profile_share_import` 出一份计划，你同意后再执行，最后把仍缺的凭据列给你，和
**首次配置** 页面是同一份清单。

为什么需要这段引导语而不是全自动：裸 DSH 里没有任何东西能在「认得 `DSH-SHARE/1:` 的插件」装好
之前认出这个前缀。要彻底去掉这段话，得在 DSH 内核里加前缀识别；在那之前，这两行提示就是接缝。
section: 在还没装插件的机器上接码

text:
@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · Agent 工具：| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `profile_share_import` | 预览分享码；`apply: true` 时执行 |
| `profile_share_requirements` | 列出本 profile 仍缺的凭据，并给出与页面相同的申请指引 |
| `profile_share_authorize` | 列出授权流程、发起、查看提问、回答非密钥类问题、取消 |

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 实现方式：Host 半边（`index.js`）只调用公开服务，因此配置校验、profile 文件锁与热重载仍由 Loader 负责：

| 服务调用 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `pluginManager.listBundles()` / `listPlugins()` | 读取实时清单 |
| `configEditor.configuration()` | 读取每个配置行的显式覆盖层 |
| `configEditor.edit()` | 通过 profile patch 写回配置 |
| `installBundle()` / `setBundleEnabled()` / `setPluginEnabled()` | 安装与开关 |

六个端点位于 `/api/dsh-profile-sync/`：`state`、`export`、`preview`、`apply`、`requirements`、
`configure`。写操作要求 `application/json` 且同源，并复用宿主自身的 `connection.requestRejection`
准入判定。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 实现方式：Client 半边（`client.js`）是一个通过 `ctx.slots.register` 注册的 `settings.section` 页面，只依赖
`react`，没有构建步骤。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 安全说明：- 导出时默认移除疑似凭据字段（`apiKey`、`token`、`secret`、`password`、`cookie` 等），并列出被移除
  的路径。勾选「包含可能的密钥字段」是一个明确、主动的动作。
- 分享码携带的是 `apiKeyEnv` 这类**变量名**，不是它指向的密钥。
- 写操作仅限同源，并且走 profile 自己的配置编辑器，因此每次变更都是一条正常的、可审阅的 profile
  patch。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 语义边界：- DSH 安装自带的内置 bundle（`availability: 'installation'`）永远不会被安装——它们随 DSH 分发。
  但它们的配置覆盖层仍会被分享，因为那才是复刻配置的关键。
- 发送方自己没有安装的 bundle 不会进分享码，会在 `stats.uninstalled` 里报出。
- 注册表来源按其声明安装；`git+…`、`file:…` 这类声明原样透传，不会被猜成 `name@version`。
- 「完整对齐」默认关闭：除非你明确要求，否则不会禁用或删除任何东西。

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 目录结构：```
index.js            Host 半边：六个端点、快照编解码、计划/应用引擎
client.js           Client 半边：设置页（三个标签页）
cordis.patch.yml    插入插件行的 bundle patch
locale/             插件标题与描述的本地化资源

@sldmn233/dsh-profile-share README · 开发：没有构建步骤，没有运行时依赖。

```sh
npm run check              # 两个半边的语法检查
node test/local-smoke.mjs  # 运行离线测试
```

测试覆盖：导出与密钥剥离、幂等回放、空 profile 上安装 → 启用 → 写配置、凭据需求检测、`configure`
路径白名单、跨源拒绝、内置 bundle 永不排入安装、行级启用状态同步，以及热重载时的路由注册撞名。
